faqs.question: Can White Mist be used in both Front Load and Top Load machines?
faqs.answer: Yes! White Mist is specially engineered with a low-foam, high-dispersion surfactant formula that is 100% safe and effective in both Front Load and Top Load washing machines, as well as bucket handwashing.

faqs.question: Does White Mist leave white powdery residue on dark clothes?
faqs.answer: Never. Unlike traditional detergent powders that rely on insoluble chalk fillers, White Mist is a completely liquid micro-soluble formulation that leaves zero chalky marks.

faqs.question: What is the recommended dosage for a standard load?
faqs.answer: Use 40 ml (approx. 1 cap) for a regular 5–6 kg wash load. For heavy or extra soiled garments, use 60 ml (1.5 caps).

faqs.question: Is White Mist safe for baby clothes and delicate fabrics?
faqs.answer: Our Floral Bloom variant is 100% bleach-free, phosphate-free, and pH neutral, making it ideal for delicate silks, baby wear, and sensitive skin.

brandStory.heroSubtitle: Born from a simple belief: your favorite clothes deserve more than harsh chalk powders.
brandStory.vision: To deliver clinical-grade stain removal combined with gentle silk-like yarn conditioning in every Indian household.
brandStory.mission: Zero chalk residue, 100% instant cold water dissolution, and 70% reduced virgin plastic waste.
storyParagraphs: Traditional washing powders rely on cheap limestone or calcium carbonate fillers that settle into cloth weaves, causing stiff fabric, faded colors, and scratchy collars.
White Mist was engineered from the molecular level up. Our active bio-surfactants penetrate deep into fiber yarns within 3 seconds of water contact, lifting stains from the inside out.
Engineered for front and top-loading automatic machines, our low-foam rinse technology protects sensitive electronic motors while saving up to 40% water per wash cycle.

benefits.title: 70°C Hot Sterilization
benefits.desc: Eliminates 99.99% of bacteria, viruses, and stubborn grease from Indian kadhais, oily pans, and baby clothes.

benefits.title: 40dB Whisper Quiet
benefits.desc: Acoustic insulation panels and BLDC EcoSilent motors ensure disturbance-free washing, perfect for night cycles.

benefits.title: 70% Water Saving
benefits.desc: Uses only 9.5 liters of water per eco cycle compared to 40+ liters required during traditional manual tap handwashing.

benefits.title: 2-Year Direct Warranty
benefits.desc: Comprehensive door-step coverage, free installation by certified technicians, and 10-year motor guarantee.

ingredientsUsage.heading: Certified Formulation & Precise Dosing
ingredientsUsage.subtitle: Pure, safe, and laboratory-verified ingredients designed for maximum cleaning performance with zero garment wear.

activeIngredients.name: Bio-Enzymes (Protease, Amylase, Lipase)
activeIngredients.purpose: Breaks down proteins, starches, and oily residue into water-soluble molecules

activeIngredients.name: Plant-Derived Non-Ionic Surfactants
activeIngredients.purpose: Gentle lifting action with low foam index for machine pump longevity

activeIngredients.name: Micro-Encapsulated Fragrance Spheres
activeIngredients.purpose: Slow-release floral and ocean scents activated by body heat and movement

activeIngredients.name: Anti-Redeposition Polymers
activeIngredients.purpose: Prevents suspended dirt from settling back onto clean garments during rinse
